Not covered by this API test: Auction-specific configuration is not available in the provided vocabulary; the plan uses the RFQ pricing round as the auction..
Plan “Create an RFQ auction, invite one vendor, publish it, and withdraw it with a remark” on PROCOL DEMO
Setup: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
setup · Chosen by the caller: vendor “QA vendor 1”.
setup · Sign in as the buyer: worked — Using Procol Support's web-console session for PROCOL DEMO — the app accepted it (role: super_admin).
setup · Create the draft event: worked — Draft Z2dnY2RY was created with one line item (73 KG).
setup · Add the pricing round: worked — Round 1 (pricing round, RFQ) was attached as WFFEa1Fn; bidding open 02:12–02:32.
· act 1: The buyer publishes the event. — The app accepted it (HTTP 200).
· act 2: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round for a second QA vendor. — The app accepted it (HTTP 200).
✓ act 3: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_withdraw_…”. — The app accepted it (HTTP 200).
✓ verify 1: As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals withdrawn. — status is “withdrawn”: yes ("withdrawn")
Verdict: passed — The app accepted it, as the case expects. The read-back shows what the case expects.
